name: PR Preview Deployment

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened, closed]
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read
  pages: write
  id-token: write

jobs:
  preview:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Setup UV
        uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@v6
        with:
          python-version: "3.13"

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          uv sync --extra nn-cpu --extra docs

      - name: Setup Git user
        run: |
          git config --global user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config --global user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"

      - name: Get PR number
        id: pr
        run: |
          echo "number=${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Get changed docs URLs
        id: changed_docs
        run: |
          python scripts/get_changed_docs_urls.py
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Deploy PR preview
        if: github.event.action != 'closed'
        run: |
          uv run mike deploy --update-aliases --allow-empty --push "pr/${{ steps.pr.outputs.number }}" latest
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Cleanup PR preview
        if: github.event.action == 'closed'
        run: |
          uv run mike delete "pr/${{ steps.pr.outputs.number }}"
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Post PR comment
        if: github.event.action != 'closed'
        uses: actions/github-script@v7
        with:
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          script: |
            const { number } = context.issue;
            const previewUrl = `https://docs.sleap.ai/pr/${number}/`;
            const changedUrls = `${{ steps.changed_docs.outputs.urls }}`.split('\n').filter(url => url.trim()).join('\n');
            
            const commentBody = `
            ## 📝 Documentation Preview
            
            This PR's documentation preview is now available at:
            
            [${previewUrl}](${previewUrl})
            
            ${changedUrls ? `### 🔍 Changed Pages\n\n${changedUrls}` : ''}
            
            [View markdown source](https://github.com/talmolab/sleap/blob/develop/docs/)
            `;
            
            // First, try to find existing comment
            const comments = await github.rest.issues.listComments({
              owner: context.repo.owner,
              repo: context.repo.repo,
              issue_number: number
            });
            
            const existingComment = comments.data.find(comment => 
              comment.body.includes('Documentation Preview')
            );
            
            if (existingComment) {
              // Update existing comment
              await github.rest.issues.updateComment({
                owner: context.repo.owner,
                repo: context.repo.repo,
                comment_id: existingComment.id,
                body: commentBody
              });
            } else {
              // Create new comment
              await github.rest.issues.createComment({
                owner: context.repo.owner,
                repo: context.repo.repo,
                issue_number: number,
                body: commentBody
              });
            }
